title: Flavio Pineda
text: I am a theoretical physicist specializing in theoretical cosmology, the physics of the early universe, inflation, and particle production. I am currently interested in exploring the early universe using QFT techniques. This includes, among other things, particle production by gravitational effects, the emission of Primordial Gravitational Waves (PGW), Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) formation, multi-field inflationary models, generation of large non-Gaussianities, dark matter production in the early universe, CMB physics and the exploration of the reheating stage. I am also into Neutron Stars, Many-Body physics and Statistical Mechanics.

title: Research
text: My research focuses on Early Universe Cosmology, exploring the interplay between quantum field theory and gravity in the context of inflation and its observable consequences.

title: Research
text:
Multi-field Inflation
I study inflationary models involving multiple scalar fields, where the geometry of field space plays a crucial role in the dynamics of perturbations. These models naturally lead to rich phenomenology beyond single-field scenarios.

title: Research
text:
Primordial Non-Gaussianities
A central aspect of my work is the computation of non-Gaussian signatures generated during inflation. These provide a powerful probe of high-energy physics and can be tested through cosmological observations.

title: Research
text:
Cosmological Collider Physics
I am interested in the idea that inflation acts as a cosmological collider, allowing us to probe massive fields and interactions at energy scales far beyond terrestrial experiments.

title: Research
section: Primordial Black Holes and Gravitational Waves
text:
Primordial Black Holes and Gravitational Waves
I explore the formation of Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) from enhanced curvature perturbations, and their associated gravitational wave signatures, which may offer observable windows into the early universe.

title: Research
text:
Computational Tools
Alongside analytical work, I develop computational tools for cosmology, including:

primordialpy: a Python package for numerical calculations in inflationary models

title: Flavio Pineda
text:
Current Projects
I am currently focusing on bridging the gap between theoretical frameworks and computational implementation:

Non-Gaussianities: Calculating primordial fluctuations in multi-field models.
Gravitational Particle Production: Investigating reheating and gravitational effects.
Software Development: Developing primordialpy, a Python library for cosmological calculations.
